.forgejo/workflows/release.yml.contents:
name: Release

# Only main publishes. A manual reviewed-branch run exercises the full paired
# build/image smoke but does NOT publish or update the chart.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  # Forgejo's ubuntu-latest label currently uses node:22-bookworm and Podman's
  # Docker-compatible API. Use its portable builder; no Buildx package/plugin.
  DOCKER_BUILDKIT: "0"
jobs:
  publish:
    name: Build and publish paired web/backend
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      PACKAGE_USER: ${{ secrets.PACKAGE_USER }}
      PACKAGE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PACKAGE_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - uses: https://data.forgejo.org/actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Resolve paired immutable version
        run: |
          repository="$(echo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          echo "IMAGE=git.modig.online/$repository" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "VERSION=sha-${GITHUB_SHA:0:7}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - uses: https://github.com/actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-web-build
      - name: Install build and container tools
        run: |
          apt-get update
          apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends docker.io libudev-dev libwayland-dev python3
      - name: Install wasm-opt
        env:
          BINARYEN: version_131
        run: |
          curl -fsSL "https://github.com/WebAssembly/binaryen/releases/download/$BINARYEN/binaryen-$BINARYEN-x86_64-linux.tar.gz" \
            | tar xz --strip-components=2 -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin" "binaryen-$BINARYEN/bin/wasm-opt"
          wasm-opt --version
      # Serialized native/WASM compilation to avoid simultaneous Bevy compilers.
      - name: Build and test backend
        run: |
          cargo test --locked
          cargo build --locked --release --bin ryggattack-server
          mkdir -p dist/server
          cp target/release/ryggattack-server dist/server/
      - name: Build the web bundle
        run: scripts/build-web.sh
      - name: Build both runtime images
        run: |
          for component in web server; do
            docker build --file "$component/Dockerfile" \
              --tag "$IMAGE/$component:$VERSION" \
              --label "org.opencontainers.image.source=$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --label "org.opencontainers.image.revision=$GITHUB_SHA" \
              --label "org.opencontainers.image.version=$VERSION" .
          done
      - name: Exercise actual hardened containers and sockets
        run: CONTAINER_SMOKE_NETWORK_CONTAINER="$HOSTNAME" node scripts/container-smoke.mjs "$IMAGE/web:$VERSION" "$IMAGE/server:$VERSION"
      - name: Log in to Forgejo container registry
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && env.PACKAGE_USER != '' && env.PACKAGE_TOKEN != ''
        run: |
          printf '%s' "$PACKAGE_TOKEN" | docker login git.modig.online --username "$PACKAGE_USER" --password-stdin
      - name: Publish paired images before changing desired deployment
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && env.PACKAGE_USER != '' && env.PACKAGE_TOKEN != ''
        run: |
          for component in web server; do
            docker push "$IMAGE/$component:$VERSION"
            docker tag "$IMAGE/$component:$VERSION" "$IMAGE/$component:latest"
            docker push "$IMAGE/$component:latest"
          done
      # Checkout's scoped workflow token supplies repo write access; PACKAGE_TOKEN
      # is package-only. Fail rather than overwriting a newer source revision.
      - name: Commit paired chart appVersion after successful publication
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && env.PACKAGE_USER != '' && env.PACKAGE_TOKEN != ''
        run: |
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          python3 scripts/update-chart-version.py "$VERSION"
          git config user.name 'Ryggattack release'
          git config user.email 'ryggattack-release@modig.online'
          git add charts/ryggattack/Chart.yaml
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore: deploy paired $VERSION [skip ci]"
            git push origin HEAD:main
          fi

scripts/build-web.sh.contents:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the WebAssembly version of Ryggattack into dist/web/.
#
# Usage: scripts/build-web.sh [--debug]
#
# Requires the wasm32-unknown-unknown target and a wasm-bindgen CLI whose
# version matches the wasm-bindgen crate in Cargo.lock.

set -euo pipefail

project_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$project_root"

profile="release"
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --debug) profile="debug" ;;
    *)
      echo "unknown argument: $arg" >&2
      exit 2
      ;;
  esac
done

out_dir="dist/web"
target_dir="target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/$profile"

# Toolchains installed some other way (Nix, a distribution package) ship their
# own target list, so only rustup-managed ones are checked here.
if command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1 &&
  ! rustup target list --installed | grep -qx wasm32-unknown-unknown; then
  echo "error: the wasm32-unknown-unknown target is missing." >&2
  echo "       run: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown" >&2
  exit 1
fi

expected="$(scripts/wasm-bindgen-version.sh)"

if ! command -v wasm-bindgen >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "error: wasm-bindgen was not found on PATH." >&2
  echo "       run: cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version $expected" >&2
  exit 1
fi

actual="$(wasm-bindgen --version | awk '{print $2}')"
if [ "$expected" != "$actual" ]; then
  echo "error: wasm-bindgen CLI $actual does not match the wasm-bindgen crate $expected." >&2
  echo "       run: cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version $expected --force" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [ "$profile" = "release" ]; then
  cargo build --release --bin ryggattack --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
else
  cargo build --bin ryggattack --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
fi

rm -rf "$out_dir"
mkdir -p "$out_dir"

bindgen_args=(--target web --no-typescript --out-dir "$out_dir")
if [ "$profile" = "release" ]; then
  # The symbol name section is roughly a third of the bundle and only feeds
  # readable JavaScript stack traces, which a release build does not need.
  bindgen_args+=(--remove-name-section --remove-producers-section)
fi

wasm-bindgen "${bindgen_args[@]}" "$target_dir/ryggattack.wasm"

# Optional, because it needs Binaryen rather than anything cargo installs.
# A host that cannot compress the response serves the module at its full size,
# so releases are built where this is available and take the smaller one.
module="$out_dir/ryggattack_bg.wasm"
if [ "$profile" = "release" ] && command -v wasm-opt >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  before="$(wc -c <"$module")"
  # The feature flags have to cover whatever the current rustc emits. They are
  # not a wish list: wasm-opt rejects a module using anything it was not told
  # about, which fails this build rather than shipping a broken one.
  wasm-opt -Oz \
    --enable-bulk-memory \
    --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int \
    -o "$module.opt" "$module"
  mv "$module.opt" "$module"
  after="$(wc -c <"$module")"
  echo "wasm-opt: $((before / 1000000)) MB -> $((after / 1000000)) MB"
elif [ "$profile" = "release" ]; then
  echo "note: wasm-opt was not found, so the module keeps its full size."
fi

cp web/index.html web/refresh-rate.mjs web/rooms.mjs "$out_dir/"
if [ -d assets ]; then
  cp -R assets "$out_dir/assets"
fi

echo
echo "Built $out_dir. Serve it with:"
echo "  python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory $out_dir"

web/Dockerfile.contents:
# Packages the built web bundle behind nginx.
#
# The bundle is not compiled here — build it first, then build the image from
# the repository root:
#
#   scripts/build-web.sh
#   docker build -f web/Dockerfile -t ryggattack-web .
#   docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 ryggattack-web
#
# The stable line picks up nginx security updates on rebuild; the one module
# this image depends on is asserted below rather than assumed.

FROM nginx:1.30-alpine

LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title="Ryggattack (web)" \
      org.opencontainers.image.description="The Ryggattack WebAssembly build, served by nginx"

# Fail the build, not the container, if a future base image drops the module
# that serves the pre-compressed bundle.
RUN nginx -V 2>&1 | grep -q -- --with-http_gzip_static_module

COPY web/nginx-main.conf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
COPY web/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
COPY dist/web /usr/share/nginx/html

# Roughly 50 MB of WebAssembly gzips to 15 MB. Doing it once at build time
# beats doing it on every download. `gzip -k` is not in busybox, hence `-c`.
RUN chmod 0644 /etc/nginx/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf \
    && chmod -R a+rX /usr/share/nginx/html \
    && gzip -9 -c /usr/share/nginx/html/ryggattack_bg.wasm > /usr/share/nginx/html/ryggattack_bg.wasm.gz \
    && gzip -9 -c /usr/share/nginx/html/ryggattack.js > /usr/share/nginx/html/ryggattack.js.gz \
    && nginx -t \
    && rm -f /tmp/nginx.pid

USER 101:101
ENTRYPOINT ["nginx"]
CMD ["-g", "daemon off;"]
EXPOSE 8080

server/Dockerfile.contents:
# Native executable is compiled/tested by CI before packaging, just like WASM.
# Build on glibc <= 2.41 (CI node:22-bookworm); runtime supplies glibc and libgcc.
FROM debian:trixie-slim
# The base already supplies libgcc-s1 (also required by apt itself). Assert it
# instead of running a redundant network install that needs an _apt UID mapping.
RUN ldconfig -p | grep -q 'libgcc_s.so.1'
COPY dist/server/ryggattack-server /usr/local/bin/ryggattack-server
RUN chmod 0555 /usr/local/bin/ryggattack-server
USER 10001:10001
EXPOSE 8787 8788
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/ryggattack-server"]
CMD ["0.0.0.0:8787"]
